name: glyph-matrix
title: Glyph Matrix
description: A grid of monospace glyphs where a few cells at a time swap character and brightness. Fades towards the bottom and stills under reduced motion.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Size of a cell, and of its font, in pixels.

props.name: mutationRate
props.description: Share of the cells that change on each tick, from 0 to 1.

props.name: fadeBottom
props.description: How much the matrix fades towards the bottom, from 0 to 1.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS color. Defaults to the muted foreground token.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
